expertise: Detector evidence, lifecycle binding, and release validation

semantic_votes.rationale: The three HTTP status codes are diagnostic topic keywords; this trigger line assigns no fixed response or retry policy.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The status detector applies when a numeric status governs behavior, not when a routing trigger inventories gateway symptoms.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the diagnostic keywords and exclude non-prescriptive trigger inventories from the fixed-status detector.

semantic_votes.rationale: The two-failure boundary deliberately stops an unchanged investigation loop and requires new evidence before another attempt.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Repository agent discipline owns the same-path loop breaker, and this Skill narrows it to repeated failure analysis.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain the boundary and record the new evidence that justifies resuming the investigation.

semantic_votes.rationale: Selecting exactly one analysis mode prevents incompatible deliverables and keeps one source-backed contract authoritative for the request.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Engineering change analysis owns exclusive selection among implementation, diagnosis, impact, and explanation modes.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Preserve mode exclusivity and split genuinely separable requests before analysis begins.

semantic_votes.rationale: Requiring one changed dimension ensures a new attempt tests a different hypothesis instead of replaying the failed path.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Repeat failure analysis owns retry learning across hypothesis, instrumentation, reproduction, ownership, and validation choices.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Name the changed dimension in the evidence ledger before executing the next attempt.

semantic_votes.rationale: Binding revision and behavior inputs to artifact identity proves that promotion and rollback address the intended build.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The CI/CD capability owns hosted-pipeline provenance and immutable artifact promotion semantics.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the identity chain and document any rebuild equivalence contract explicitly.

semantic_votes.rationale: The word requires belongs to a relative clause naming a reopening trigger, not an unconditional mechanism command.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Threat modeling owns residual-risk review conditions; the mechanism detector does not apply to this relative-clause grammar.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain the reopening condition and distinguish relative trigger clauses from imperative rules.

semantic_votes.rationale: A benchmark cannot support a comparative verdict unless its task, treatments, measures, caveats, and result are all defined.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Skill efficacy benchmarking owns the minimum schema for auditable baseline-versus-treatment evidence.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain the fields and mark unavailable measures with explicit proof limits rather than omitting them.

semantic_votes.rationale: Explicit production targeting and protected credential channels prevent accidental environment selection and command-line secret exposure.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: CLI and daemon interface design owns production invocation safety where credentials or destructive targets are accepted.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep both safeguards and permit alternate credential transports only when they avoid history and process listings.

semantic_votes.rationale: One mode paired with one reference prevents cross-mode instruction blending and bounds the analysis context to its selected contract.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The professional analysis router owns the single-mode and just-in-time reference selection boundary.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the pair exclusive and create a separate task when another mode is independently necessary.

semantic_votes.rationale: Write-behind acknowledges before durable backing storage, so explicit durability and recovery proof is necessary for that selected mode.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Cache design owns this condition only when write-behind behavior is proposed or already present.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain the conditional proof requirement and choose write-through when the loss window is unacceptable.

semantic_votes.rationale: Classifying each invariant by consistency locality exposes which NoSQL guarantees can enforce it and which cannot.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: NoSQL database design owns invariant placement across item, partition, aggregate, and cross-boundary scopes.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Preserve the classification and record compensating controls for invariants outside the database guarantee.

semantic_votes.rationale: The frontmatter phrase describes when this Skill is routed, rather than commanding every review to cross an agent boundary.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Task handoff context applies only when an actual handoff must cross the stated boundary.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the routing trigger and exclude frontmatter use-conditions from unconditional mechanism findings.

semantic_votes.rationale: Explicit lifecycle coverage is essential to detect unrepresented valid conditions, overlapping states, and ambiguous transition outcomes.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: State machine modeling owns coverage and precedence whenever lifecycle state represents business facts.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain the coverage rule and document intentional impossible states or precedence choices.

semantic_votes.rationale: A required check is not operationally defined without its trigger, scope, protected target, terminal states, and retry semantics.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: CI/CD owns the contract of checks designated as required by repository or branch policy.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the complete check contract and explicitly mark any intentionally unsupported terminal behavior.

semantic_votes.rationale: The rule inventory, negative fixture, and exception policy jointly prove enforcement coverage, rejection behavior, and governed escape paths.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Architecture enforcement tooling owns these artifacts when a machine-enforced boundary is introduced or changed.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain all three artifacts and refresh them with every material enforcement rule change.

semantic_votes.rationale: This use-condition says conflicting evidence may call for invalidation or escalation; it mandates neither response unconditionally.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Agent execution discipline is routed when evidence conflict raises that possibility, with the concrete response decided from the conflict.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Preserve the conditional routing language and ignore modal use-conditions in the mechanism detector.

semantic_votes.rationale: Risk-triggered releases need named approval, observation ownership, and stop signals so rollout decisions remain actionable under failure.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Delivery release gate owns these controls for releases whose assessed risk requires staged rollout oversight.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the controls proportional to release risk and record when a low-risk path makes them not applicable.

semantic_votes.rationale: Negative-path tests, cost limits, and escalation ownership are distinct evidence needed for safe BigData product extension.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The BigData domain extension owns these artifacts when data scale, spend, or failure behavior is materially changed.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain each record and scope its depth to the changed pipeline and operational exposure.

semantic_votes.rationale: Mapping every material criterion to an observable signal prevents acceptance language that cannot support a completion decision.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Acceptance criteria builder owns verifiability for criteria classified as material to the requested outcome.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the mapping and state the proof limit whenever the available signal is indirect.

semantic_votes.rationale: Every material invariant needs a test, review check, or declared evidence gap to avoid silently unverified business rules.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Business invariant analysis owns proof mapping for invariants that constrain the change under review.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Preserve the mapping and escalate uncovered invariants rather than treating missing proof as success.

semantic_votes.rationale: Establishing fact authority before schema shape prevents duplicate writers, ambiguous ownership, and lifecycle semantics hidden by storage design.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Data model design owns source-of-truth, mutation-authority, and lifecycle evidence for each changed fact.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep authority explicit and resolve competing writers before selecting physical representation.

semantic_votes.rationale: The four connected dimensions form the Skill's complete risk model and prevent a design review from checking only implementation shape.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: High risk design review owns this fixed model for briefs routed through its deeper evidence path.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain all dimensions while scaling evidence depth to the concrete risk in each dimension.

semantic_votes.rationale: Naming Kubernetes is intrinsic to this Kubernetes-specific capability and output contract, not an arbitrary vendor preference.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Kubernetes gateway owns runtime decisions only after routing has selected this platform-specific Skill.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the platform name and route non-Kubernetes gateway work to the generic protocol capability.

semantic_votes.rationale: Completion evidence must be current or explicitly inapplicable so stale artifacts and silent omissions cannot satisfy the gate.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The main control agent owns evidence-ledger closure for items required by the accepted task contract.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain freshness and applicability checks, including a reason whenever an item is marked not applicable.

semantic_votes.rationale: Proportional breadth prevents both superficial high-risk review and irrelevant ceremony that obscures the actual failure exposure.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: High risk design review owns breadth calibration against the concrete risks identified in the brief.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the proportionality rule and state which risk justifies each added review dimension.

semantic_votes.rationale: Loading only decision-changing references preserves just-in-time context and prevents speculative catalogs from diluting applicable instructions.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Task context selection owns reference admission at the point where a registered trigger affects the next decision.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain selective loading and log the trigger that justified each admitted reference.

semantic_votes.rationale: The prohibition on implementation and review preserves the Control Skill as a router instead of creating a competing execution authority.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Engineering control plane owns routing and template indexing only, with task and review agents owning downstream work.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the boundary explicit and move any professional judgment into the routed Skill or Profile.

semantic_votes.rationale: Mapping each acceptance and material risk to the smallest sufficient test level avoids both unproven behavior and redundant broad tests.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Quality test gate owns test-level selection for the accepted criteria and risk model of the change.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Preserve the mapping and escalate test breadth only when the lower level cannot observe the failure mechanism.

semantic_votes.rationale: Questions that depend on target source or professional evidence cannot be answered reliably through the direct task route.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The main control prompt owns route selection between Direct Task and source-backed Analyzed Work.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain this routing boundary and keep simple evidence-independent questions on the direct path.

semantic_votes.rationale: Exactly one selected mode keeps the requested output coherent and stops analysis references from imposing contradictory responsibilities.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Engineering change analysis defines mutually exclusive supported modes before any mode-specific reference is loaded.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Maintain single-mode selection and decompose mixed requests into separately contracted analyses.

semantic_votes.rationale: Every changed file needs explicit validation coverage so ancillary edits cannot bypass the plan's proof obligations.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Plan execution consistency owns reconciliation between the final change set and its validation evidence.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep file-level coverage and record a justified non-executable review check where tests do not apply.

semantic_votes.rationale: A selected Skill or reference absent from built output makes the routing decision unusable in the installed product.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Routing quality review owns build-presence verification for every route selected by the reviewed configuration.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain the built-output check and reject routes that exist only in source registries.

semantic_votes.rationale: A single bounded task has no dependency graph to plan and belongs in the simpler Direct Task Capsule route.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Task DAG decomposition owns the anti-trigger separating one bounded task from multi-task scheduling.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the one-task boundary and form a DAG only after identifying independently useful nodes.

semantic_votes.rationale: One proving signal per acceptance criterion or material failure path creates an auditable minimum without requiring duplicate evidence.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Quality test gate owns the minimum proof map; additional signals remain allowed when one cannot establish the outcome.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain the minimum and add corroboration only where the selected signal has a material proof gap.

semantic_votes.rationale: Two tasks are the logical minimum for dependencies, parallel value, or integration edges to form a meaningful DAG.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Task DAG planner is routed only when an accepted brief contains at least two real task nodes.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the numeric trigger and reject artificial node splitting introduced only to satisfy it.

semantic_votes.rationale: Gateway diagnosis needs hop, upstream result, duration, and retry context to distinguish edge failure from origin failure and amplification.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Network protocol gateway usage owns this telemetry requirement when a distributed gateway path is under diagnosis or change.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain the diagnostic fields while redacting sensitive values and omitting fields proven irrelevant to the path.

semantic_votes.rationale: The two-task threshold expresses the minimum cardinality for dependency, critical-path, parallelism, and integration planning.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Task DAG decomposition applies when two or more independently useful tasks require structured scheduling.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Preserve the threshold and use a Direct Task Capsule when the work remains one bounded unit.

semantic_votes.rationale: Review evidence predating a material edit cannot establish that the final implementation still satisfies its acceptance and risk constraints.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The main control agent owns completion freshness after the latest material implementation change.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep post-edit review mandatory and define materiality in the task evidence when a change is non-semantic.

semantic_votes.rationale: Every active consumer must survive the deployed schema transition because one incompatible reader can break the shared data product.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The BigData extension owns mixed-consumer compatibility for active readers within the changed schema's deployment window.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain consumer verification and explicitly retire inactive consumers before excluding them from the compatibility set.

semantic_votes.rationale: The phrase describes a routing condition for deeper design review; it does not prescribe a universal evidence mechanism.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: High risk design review applies when a critical path creates the stated need for deeper evidence.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the trigger and exclude frontmatter condition fragments from unconditional mechanism classification.

semantic_votes.rationale: Validation run before the final repository edit may no longer cover the delivered tree and therefore cannot close the plan.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Plan execution consistency owns validation freshness relative to the last repository-changing action.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain final-tree validation and rerun only the checks whose evidence was invalidated by the edit.

semantic_votes.rationale: Acceptance requires final-edit validation and review of the complete change set so no material file escapes independent assessment.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The main control prompt owns implementation completion across task-agent output and review-agent evidence.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep both gates and explicitly enumerate every changed file supplied to the reviewer.

semantic_votes.rationale: When direct reproduction is unsafe or environment-specific, a coherent causal chain and considered alternatives are the necessary substitute proof.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Failure diagnosis owns this fallback only when controlled reproduction is unavailable or would create unacceptable risk.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain the conditional fallback and label its residual uncertainty rather than claiming reproduced causality.

semantic_votes.rationale: Classifying the request into one supported mode gives downstream analysis a single output contract and prevents scope collision.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Engineering change analysis owns classification within its enumerated modes before evidence gathering starts.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep exclusive classification and return unsupported or compound requests for bounded decomposition.

semantic_votes.rationale: Current permission, redaction, and approval evidence is necessary when a data or API contract changes protected exposure or authority.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Data API contract changer owns these safeguards for affected sensitive fields, callers, and approval boundaries.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain risk-triggered evidence and mark controls not applicable only after confirming no protected exposure changed.

semantic_votes.rationale: Prohibiting catalog preload enforces just-in-time context selection and protects the main agent's bounded control-plane budget.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The main control agent owns the no-catalog boundary before a concrete professional trigger selects a reference.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the prohibition and access only the router entry needed for the current dispatch decision.

semantic_votes.rationale: Runbook appears among document types in a routing list; the line does not require a runbook for every documentation task.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Documentation generation selects the artifact type from the user's requested documentation outcome and repository need.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the document-type inventory and exclude optional artifact lists from mandatory-artifact detection.

semantic_votes.rationale: Independent acceptance requires the actual diff and every changed file; summaries alone can conceal defects or omitted scope.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The main control agent owns the evidence package handed to review-agent after task-agent implementation.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain complete review input and identify generated or binary files with an equivalent inspectable artifact.

semantic_votes.rationale: Evidence must exercise the actual failure mechanism and consequential negative outcomes to distinguish a fix from adjacent passing behavior.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Code review owns proof sufficiency for mechanisms and risks materially affected by the reviewed change.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep mechanism-focused proof and document any negative outcome that cannot be safely exercised.

semantic_votes.rationale: Two independently useful tasks are the minimum set in which a real dependency or parallel benefit can exist.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Task DAG decomposition owns this entry condition before introducing nodes, edges, or integration checkpoints.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the cardinality check and avoid splitting one task into administrative fragments.

semantic_votes.rationale: Material artifact claims need current source or named owner evidence so review does not endorse unsupported or stale assertions.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Engineering artifact review owns claim verification within the artifact and repository scope under review.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain source verification and label claims as unproven when authoritative evidence is unavailable.

semantic_votes.rationale: One primary Professional Skill establishes a single responsibility contract while allowing triggered Foundation and Domain support to remain subordinate.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The main control agent owns primary Skill routing through the professional Skill router for each analyzed task.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep one primary owner and decompose work when separate professional contracts are independently required.

semantic_votes.rationale: The phrase identifies routing topics whose closure behavior calls for judgment evidence; it imposes no unconditional evidence mechanism.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Senior programming judgment core applies when the listed authoring or build decisions require bounded professional judgment.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Preserve the routing vocabulary and teach the detector to ignore conditional topic inventories.

semantic_votes.rationale: Deriving discriminating observations from competing hypotheses prevents diagnosis from collecting evidence that cannot distinguish plausible mechanisms.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Failure diagnosis owns hypothesis-driven observation selection while the cause remains unresolved.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep supporting and counter-evidence requirements and revise hypotheses when observations contradict their predictions.

semantic_votes.rationale: Per-case namespaces and owned cleanup prevent integration tests from leaking state, colliding in parallel, or contaminating later results.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Integration testing owns isolation for shared fixtures, schemas, topics, key spaces, and transaction state used by each case.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain owned isolation and make cleanup idempotent so partial setup and failed assertions are recoverable.

semantic_votes.rationale: The rule conditionally requires CSRF proof only where ambient browser authority has not already been ruled out.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Security privacy gate owns request-integrity proof for browser-reachable state changes with unproven ambient credentials.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain the narrow trigger and record the authority analysis when CSRF proof is deemed unnecessary.

semantic_votes.rationale: Evidence of real consumers and distinct change reasons is necessary before abstraction, otherwise extension points encode imagined variation.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Extensibility design owns the abstraction threshold for the current consumers, ownership boundaries, and observed variation.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the evidence threshold and defer abstraction until at least one concrete variation is demonstrated.

semantic_votes.rationale: A regression guard must reproduce the causal trigger because adjacent correct behavior can pass while the original failure remains reachable.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Regression testing owns recurrence proof for the diagnosed mechanism that the change claims to prevent.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain causal reproduction and document a faithful surrogate when the original trigger cannot be safely exercised.

semantic_votes.rationale: Cleanup must run after success, assertion failure, and timeout because each termination path can leave externally visible test state.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: End-to-end testing owns cleanup across every terminal path of the scenarios it provisions.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep path-complete cleanup and add recovery evidence for resources whose deletion may itself fail.

semantic_votes.rationale: A repair changes the reviewed object, so fresh validation and re-review are required before prior blocking findings can be closed.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The main control agent owns the repair loop after review-agent reports a blocking implementation finding.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain both freshness steps and scope reruns to evidence invalidated by the repair.

semantic_votes.rationale: A DAG needs at least two real tasks, and every edge must represent a blocking fact rather than narrative ordering.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Task DAG planner owns graph construction after the brief supplies independently useful task nodes and genuine dependencies.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep both constraints and remove edges that do not change executability or integration readiness.

semantic_votes.rationale: Recording each artifact's claim and proof limit prevents evidence from being reused to support outcomes it cannot establish.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Agent execution discipline owns evidence-ledger semantics for artifacts that survive reconciliation and inform completion.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain claim-bound evidence and invalidate artifacts when their source or covered behavior changes.

semantic_votes.rationale: Current inventory, rejection fixture, and exception policy are the minimum mechanisms that make an architecture rule testable and governable.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Architecture enforcement tooling owns this proof set for every active automated architecture constraint.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Preserve synchronized enforcement evidence and fail the gate when any component becomes stale.

semantic_votes.rationale: Single successful retry and one familiar failure mode are examples of insufficient diagnosis, not fixed retry or evidence thresholds.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Failure diagnosis uses these counts inside an anti-pattern list to reject premature causal confidence.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the examples and exclude negated insufficiency examples from fixed-threshold detection.

semantic_votes.rationale: Each materially reachable recurrence needs a guard, fresh existing proof, or explicit gap so known reentry paths are not ignored.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Regression testing owns recurrence coverage for failure paths established as materially reachable in the current system.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain per-path mapping and escalate unresolved gaps instead of inventing low-fidelity tests.

semantic_votes.rationale: An observable signal plus its proof limit makes each acceptance criterion decidable without overstating what the observation establishes.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Acceptance criteria builder owns the criterion-to-signal contract before implementation or review consumes it.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep explicit proof limits and revise criteria whose proposed signals cannot observe the intended outcome.

semantic_votes.rationale: Repair invalidates earlier acceptance evidence, making fresh validation and review necessary to verify the latest diff rather than the superseded one.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The main control prompt owns completion-state transitions after a blocking finding triggers implementation repair.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the repair gate and attach the new evidence to the same Task ID lifecycle.

semantic_votes.rationale: Mixed-version windows require consumer-driven contracts or equivalent checks before lockstep release protection can be safely removed.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Microservice splitting owns compatibility proof across old and new service versions introduced by boundary extraction.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain the equivalence allowance and document which compatibility behavior each alternative check proves.

semantic_votes.rationale: The detected example markers are transition arrows in operational workflow and state tables, not tutorial examples or explanatory detours.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Main control agent uses arrows as compact executable sequencing and completion-state notation within its control contract.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the state notation and make the density detector distinguish transition arrows from example prose.

limitations: Unfilled template: every decision and rationale must be completed independently before validation.
